basic_info.description: This elegantly renovated 2BD/2BA flat with ground level bonus room and bathroom in a prime Marina/Fort Mason location features generous entertaining rooms, a remodeled eat-in kitchen, large primary suite, guest suite, and an exclusive-use deck over a large shared garden. Classic San Francisco charm combines with an elegant renovation to create a warm and inviting city residence that offers all the allure of a historic treasure without compromising modern convenience. The spacious and thoughtfully appointed home includes garage parking for two cars and an in-unit laundry room, ensuring the luxury of convenience in the city, while the exclusive and secluded deck provides ample space to entertain, relax and unwind. At the doorstep of 1242 Francisco are the San Francisco Bay Aquatic Park, Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture, Moscone Park & Playground, as well as the restaurants, shops and coffee houses of the Marina District and Polk Street. Add a healthy Homeowners Association and a coveted Marina location, it won't take long to realize this is truly a one-of-a-kind city gem offered with the transparency of sincere sellers who have maintained an impeccable home in an incomparable location.
